  1  """Renders a summary as a plain-text table."""
  2  from ledger.core.money import format_amount
  3  
  4  
  5  def render_table(summary):
  6      """One row per account, amounts right-aligned, and a total row."""
  7      width = max([len(account) for account in summary] + [len("total")])
  8      rows = [f"{account:<{width}}  {format_amount(cents):>10}" for account, cents in summary.items()]
  9      rows.append(f"{'total':<{width}}  {format_amount(sum(summary.values())):>10}")
 10      return "\n".join(rows)
